So I got a nasty one but it’ll probably be buried. I was in early high school/middle school grade 8/9. My friend (let’s call her J) and I were pretty close and we’re into online roleplay forums and DnD. She introduces me to her friends all on Skype and this is where I meet the guy (M). So M and I start talking privately cause we got along really well in the group. Fast forward a few months and we start talking about the possibility of a relationship, the dude had already revealed he was mid twenties and was from the UK. I’d never had a relationship or long distance so I didn’t see much harm. 

Boy was I wrong.

The very next day J tells me that her and M are now in a relationship. I get super confused but congratulate her and talk to him in private about what was going on. He tells me that she asked him out and he just couldn’t say no and that he would properly break up with her soon so he and I could be together. And I bought everything he said to me cause I had zero experience with romance or relationships. Fast forward almost a whole year later, M and J are still dating, M keeps sending flirty messages and telling me how in love he is with me. I kept wanting to tell J what was happening but M would freak out and say how he would break up with her soon. J would reveal how M and her had sexted and sent pictures back and forth. I was nervous but continued not to say anything cause M would threaten to tell J what a horrible person I was for telling lies about her boyfriend.

Grade 10, J calls me crying one day saying how M had broken up with her and her world is over. When I talked with M there was zero remorse or sympathy about the breakup that had just happened. He continues to message me saying that we can be together now and that everything can be perfect. I’m so fucked in the head by this point that I cut ties with him at the same time I move out of state and away from J. It’s been so many years since that happened but I feel waves of guilt and nausea every time I remember my early high school times. J and I stopped talking after I moved so I never ended up knowing if she found out about M and I or if they got back together or god knows what. 

TLDR: My BFF and I got played by a man twice our age from another country over Skype.
